title: Forecast IT support ticket volume
text: Analyze this export of support ticket volume by week for the past 12 months. Identify seasonality trends and forecast volume for the next quarter. Visualize the trend and provide commentary for capacity planning.

hook: Idea produk ada, tetapi skop, aliran pengguna atau ujian belum tersusun? Fokus: Forecast IT support ticket volume.
solution: Tugasan: Forecast IT support ticket volume. Tetapkan keperluan fungsi, aliran pengguna, skema data, sempadan keselamatan dan kriteria ujian sebelum membangunkan output.
